tasks.prepare: deno task install && deno task fonts && deno task themes && deno task licenses && deno task build:info
tasks.dev: deno task content:fetch && deno task prepare && hugo server --config frontend/tui/hugo.toml --renderToMemory
tasks.build: deno task content:fetch && deno task content:check && deno task prepare && hugo build --config frontend/tui/hugo.toml --minify --cleanDestinationDir
tasks.build:fixtures: deno task prepare && deno task content:check tests/fixtures/content && hugo build --minify --cleanDestinationDir --config frontend/tui/hugo.toml,frontend/tui/tests/fixtures/hugo.toml --destination generated/fixture-site
tasks.lint: biome ci . && taplo fmt --check && taplo lint && actionlint && deno task conventions
tasks.typecheck: deno check tools tests frontend/tui/tools frontend/tui/tests frontend/tui/assets/ts
tasks.test:e2e: deno task build:fixtures && deno task validate:html && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-env --allow-run frontend/tui/tests/e2e
tasks.check: deno task lint && deno task typecheck && deno task test
tasks.ci: deno task check && deno task test:e2e
